device: Apple Vision Pro, visionOS 26.2 or newer, Safari; flat page only (the XR session is M11b1). Records the signals, the backend and the visionOS UA string (UNVERIFIED in the spec)

steps.instruction: In Safari on visionOS open <preview>/?perf=1. The HUD shows the flat tier (the XR-capable provisional tier is mobile) and the backend. Write both in notes.json observations.

Tap Export. In notes.json check userAgent (the visionOS UA string is UNVERIFIED: record it exactly), signals.hasNavigatorXr, signals.immersiveVrSupported, signals.hasXrGpuBinding, signals.maxTouchPoints and signals.adapter. If Export does not download, connect Web Inspector from the Mac and copy JSON.stringify(__dvBridge.platform.signals()).

Copy 'signals' from notes.json into tools/ci/fixtures/ua/visionpro-safari.json (set synthetic to false, keep the expect block: class avp, headset visionpro, provisional tier mobile). If classifyDevice does not return avp for the captured signals, record which rule failed in the report as a contract proposal for 11-platform.md section 5.2; do not change the fixture's expect block.
Tap 'Run 10 min' on the HUD and keep the window in view for 10 minutes (flat page).
Tap Export; save to docs/device-spike/M01c/visionpro/. Record: backend selected, adapter summary, UA string, rafHz.
